name: Hermes Upstream — weekly check + trial merge
note: Not auto-imported — documents the live job. Converted 2026-08-21 from an agent job that only COUNTED commits (and was ignored until the fork drifted 2,918 behind) to a --no-agent script that actually trial-merges in a scratch worktree and reports an actionable verdict. Silent when up to date: empty stdout suppresses delivery. The DEPLOY stays manual — it restarts every service on the box.
edit_command: hermes cron edit hermes_upstream_sync_check --script hermes_upstream_check.sh --no-agent --name 'Hermes Upstream — weekly check + trial merge'
cadence_note: Upstream moves ~250-300 commits/day, so a weekly delta is still ~2,100 commits. Weekly is NOT about smaller deltas — it is about catching a conflict while the upstream change is fresh, and picking up security fixes within days. Size does not predict difficulty: the 2,918-commit merge on 2026-08-21 was clean. Conflicts land on the 14 local reverts, not on volume.
